re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. ### What changed
Three independent fixes for the red main CI (run 36399539696), one commit each:

That commit updated the fa_ui twin of this test and pinned the contract in `add_provider_flow_unify_test.dart` but missed the flutter_app copy — production code was already correct, only the test was stale.
2. `refactor(cli)` — extracted the diagnostic-log members (`_logDiagnostic`, `_logSid`, `_appendDiagnosticLog`, `_diagnosticLogPath`) from `agent_cli.dart` into `agent_cli_diag_log.dart` (`part of` + private extension, the established `agent_cli_banner.dart`/`agent_cli_inbox.dart` pattern). 3. `refactor(omp-reg)` — split `structuralDiff` (CRAP 17.15: CC 11 @ 63% cov) into `_chromeRows`/`_chromeRowCountFinding`, `_statusBarFindings`, `_segmentFindings` + a thin composer, with byte-identical finding texts. - Break 3 tests are characterization-first (written and run against the old monolith before the split), matching the ticket's "split + tests" contract; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

# gh-1039 — main CI fix plan: picker test + agent_cli size gate + structuralDiff CRAP

### What changed
Three independent fixes for the red main CI (run 36399539696), one commit each:
1. `test(app)` — `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` updated to the deliberate post-#975 add-provider flow (contract defined by [`d54180f0`](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/commit/d54180f0), the #975 single add-provider flow, PR #979): "Add provider" opens `AddProviderPresetPickerPage`, "Custom" routes to `ProviderEditorPage`; the saved provider then lists on the picker and opens its model page prefilled. That commit updated the fa_ui twin of this test and pinned the contract in `add_provider_flow_unify_test.dart` but missed the flutter_app copy — production code was already correct, only the test was stale.
2. `refactor(cli)` — extracted the diagnostic-log members (`_logDiagnostic`, `_logSid`, `_appendDiagnosticLog`, `_diagnosticLogPath`) from `agent_cli.dart` into `agent_cli_diag_log.dart` (`part of` + private extension, the established `agent_cli_banner.dart`/`agent_cli_inbox.dart` pattern). Pure move: 2815 → 2774 lines, zero behavior change.
3. `refactor(omp-reg)` — split `structuralDiff` (CRAP 17.15: CC 11 @ 63% cov) into `_chromeRows`/`_chromeRowCountFinding`, `_statusBarFindings`, `_segmentFindings` + a thin composer, with byte-identical finding texts. New tests pin every branch through the public API (presence drift both directions, bar-less parity, single segment-count finding, 2-item drift loop).

### Key decisions
- Break 1 keeps the new flow (not a revert): `d54180f0` (issue #975, PR #979) deliberately routed every add-provider entry through the ONE settings flow and its contract tests pin `AddProviderPresetPickerPage` opening before any editor.
- Break 2 is a mechanical extraction — the diff shows moved code only; `_diagnosticLogDirEnsured` stays on the class (extensions hold no fields).
- Break 3 tests are characterization-first (written and run against the old monolith before the split), matching the ticket's "split + tests" contract; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- No thresholds relaxed, no tests skipped or quarantined (I1/AC5).

# gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

## Handoff

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

## Open questions

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

# gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

## Handoff

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

## Open questions

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

# gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

## Handoff

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.

  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; real-provider files carry `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and

- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. # gh-1039 — main CI fix plan: picker test + agent_cli size gate + structuralDiff CRAP

### What changed
Three independent fixes for the red main CI (run 36399539696), one commit each:
1. `test(app)` — `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` updated to the deliberate post-#975 add-provider flow (contract defined by [`d54180f0`](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/commit/d54180f0), the #975 single add-provider flow, PR #979): "Add provider" opens `AddProviderPresetPickerPage`, "Custom" routes to `ProviderEditorPage`; the saved provider then lists on the picker and opens its model page prefilled. That commit updated the fa_ui twin of this test and pinned the contract in `add_provider_flow_unify_test.dart` but missed the flutter_app copy — production code was already correct, only the test was stale.
2. `refactor(cli)` — extracted the diagnostic-log members (`_logDiagnostic`, `_logSid`, `_appendDiagnosticLog`, `_diagnosticLogPath`) from `agent_cli.dart` into `agent_cli_diag_log.dart` (`part of` + private extension, the established `agent_cli_banner.dart`/`agent_cli_inbox.dart` pattern). Pure move: 2815 → 2774 lines, zero behavior change.
3. `refactor(omp-reg)` — split `structuralDiff` (CRAP 17.15: CC 11 @ 63% cov) into `_chromeRows`/`_chromeRowCountFinding`, `_statusBarFindings`, `_segmentFindings` + a thin composer, with byte-identical finding texts. New tests pin every branch through the public API (presence drift both directions, bar-less parity, single segment-count finding, 2-item drift loop).

### Key decisions
- Break 1 keeps the new flow (not a revert): `d54180f0` (issue #975, PR #979) deliberately routed every add-provider entry through the ONE settings flow and its contract tests pin `AddProviderPresetPickerPage` opening before any editor.
- Break 2 is a mechanical extraction — the diff shows moved code only; `_diagnosticLogDirEnsured` stays on the class (extensions hold no fields).
- Break 3 tests are characterization-first (written and run against the old monolith before the split), matching the ticket's "split + tests" contract; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- No thresholds relaxed, no tests skipped or quarantined (I1/AC5).

# gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

## Handoff

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

## Open questions

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. # gh-1039 — main CI fix plan: picker test + agent_cli size gate + structuralDiff CRAP

### What changed
Three independent fixes for the red main CI (run 36399539696), one commit each:
1. `test(app)` — `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` updated to the deliberate post-#975 add-provider flow (contract defined by [`d54180f0`](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/commit/d54180f0), the #975 single add-provider flow, PR #979): "Add provider" opens `AddProviderPresetPickerPage`, "Custom" routes to `ProviderEditorPage`; the saved provider then lists on the picker and opens its model page prefilled. That commit updated the fa_ui twin of this test and pinned the contract in `add_provider_flow_unify_test.dart` but missed the flutter_app copy — production code was already correct, only the test was stale.
2. `refactor(cli)` — extracted the diagnostic-log members (`_logDiagnostic`, `_logSid`, `_appendDiagnosticLog`, `_diagnosticLogPath`) from `agent_cli.dart` into `agent_cli_diag_log.dart` (`part of` + private extension, the established `agent_cli_banner.dart`/`agent_cli_inbox.dart` pattern). Pure move: 2815 → 2774 lines, zero behavior change.
3. `refactor(omp-reg)` — split `structuralDiff` (CRAP 17.15: CC 11 @ 63% cov) into `_chromeRows`/`_chromeRowCountFinding`, `_statusBarFindings`, `_segmentFindings` + a thin composer, with byte-identical finding texts. New tests pin every branch through the public API (presence drift both directions, bar-less parity, single segment-count finding, 2-item drift loop).

### Key decisions
- Break 1 keeps the new flow (not a revert): `d54180f0` (issue #975, PR #979) deliberately routed every add-provider entry through the ONE settings flow and its contract tests pin `AddProviderPresetPickerPage` opening before any editor.
- Break 2 is a mechanical extraction — the diff shows moved code only; `_diagnosticLogDirEnsured` stays on the class (extensions hold no fields).
- Break 3 tests are characterization-first (written and run against the old monolith before the split), matching the ticket's "split + tests" contract; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- No thresholds relaxed, no tests skipped or quarantined (I1/AC5).

# gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

## Handoff

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

## Open questions

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

blocks.text:
Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also

# gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

None blocking. If both Break-1 readings (revert vs update-test) look defensible, prefer reverting the accidental part and opening a follow-up card for the deliberate redesign — main goes green first.

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also

  real-provider suite (pty-integration).

  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs in the

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. # gh-1039: [ci-red] main fix plan — picker test regression + agent_cli.dart 2815>2800 + CRAP 17.15 (structuralDiff)

## Description

## Goal

One sentence: **restore a green main CI (README badge) by fixing three independent breaks from [run 36399539696](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696) — a provider-picker app-test regression, the `agent_cli.dart` file-size violation, and the CRAP ratchet exceeded by `structuralDiff` — each as its own commit, with no gate threshold relaxed and no test quarantined.**

The badge is genuinely red: three consecutive main CI failures on 2026-09-28 (07:02, 08:48, 09:07 UTC — the 09:07 rerun failed too, this is persistent, not a flake). Incident tracker: #905 (auto-filed ci-red stub; closes manually when the ref goes green). This card is its fix plan.

## Break 1 — Flutter app test regression (the semantic one)

- **Job:** Flutter app tests (shard 0/2) — [failed job](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/36399539696/job/108854105390). 1682 passed / **1 failed** / 34 skipped.
- **Test:** `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart:226` — «MediaSlotProviderPickerPage add provider continues straight to its model page»: expected exactly one `ProviderEditorPage`, **found 0**.
- **Picker log line immediately before the failure:** `[fah][picker] Edit Image generation: registry=0 providers=[] connectedOnly=false hadRegistry=true` — the picker entered the edit path with an **empty registry** and never navigated to the editor.
- **Suspects** (recent commits touching this test, newest first): `29444caf0` (one-click web sign-in popup flow), `ea56502d3` (provider UI updates), `a34cbe5e5` (CLI-parity provider connectivity — keyed presets list as providers), `cdbee1726` (on-device providers are configured-only, discoverable via Add provider).
- **Fix contract:** establish from the suspect commits which behavior is INTENDED. If the new flow is deliberate → update the test to the new contract and record the decision in the PR. If it is an accidental behavior change → restore the old flow. Do NOT weaken the assertion («found 0 is fine» is not a fix).

## Break 2 — File size guard

- **Job:** Static gates — output: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart: 2815 lines` (limit 2800, AGENTS.md quality gate #1).
- **Fix contract:** mechanical extraction following the existing repo pattern (`part of` split files — `trajectory_commands.dart`, `agent_cli_tools.dart` are `part of agent_cli.dart`). Zero behavior change; the diff must show moved code, not edited logic.

## Break 3 — CRAP ratchet

- **Job:** CRAP + duplication — `Max CRAP: 17.15 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`.
- **Offender:** `(top-level).structuralDiff` at `lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart:144` — CRAP 17.15, coverage 63.0%, complexity 11.
- **Fix contract:** split `structuralDiff` into small tested helpers (repo convention: statement coverage + CRAP gate; the ratchet only fails when coverage AND complexity are both bad — tests on the extracted helpers drop CRAP below 12). Thresholds pinned in `crap4dart.yaml` are NOT to be relaxed.

## Invariants

- **I1** — No gate threshold is relaxed (2800 lines, CRAP 12, duplication 1.0%, coverage 80%) and no test is skipped/quarantined to reach green.
- **I2** — The three breaks land as separate commits/PRs (repo convention: one logical change per commit) so reverting one cannot re-break the others.
- **I3** — The picker fix follows intent (Break-1 contract): a behavior change without the test updated to the new contract is not acceptable; a test weakened to match a bug is not acceptable.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — main CI green on two consecutive runs after merge (README badge flips).
- **AC2** — Static gates green: every `lib/ test/ example/` .dart ≤ 2800 lines; extraction-only diff.
- **AC3** — `media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` green with the intended-flow decision recorded in the PR description (link the suspect commit that defined the contract).
- **AC4** — `crap4dart analyze` green: `structuralDiff` (or its successors) CRAP ≤ 12 via split + tests; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- **AC5** — No `skip:`/`quarantine:` additions anywhere in the diff.
- **AC6** — #905 receives a closing comment referencing the fix PRs when the ref goes green.

## Test matrix

No new surface beyond: (a) the updated picker test per AC3; (b) unit tests for the new `structuralDiff` helpers per AC4; (c) the existing gates as regression guards (file-size guard, CRAP ratchet, app-test shards).

## Non-goals

- The `[daily-publish]` legs failing for 8 straight days (#857 / #855 / #1038) are a separate pipeline — out of scope here.
- The Quality-gate job failure is a rollup of Breaks 1–3; it recovers by itself once they are fixed.
- No redesign of the provider-picker UX — intent is established from history, not reinvented.

## Handoff

Assigned to `ai-teammate` (the `issues: assigned` trigger fires the factory dev leg per `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`). Machine jobs convention: link the runs back here.

## Open questions

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; real-provider files carry `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and
  run ONLY in the tag-only provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets;
  child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly (issue #553).
  Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps the full
  real-provider suite (pty-integration).
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs in the
  nightly workflow + on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet on main/nightly; PRs ratchet
  CHANGED lines via `scripts/diff_coverage.py`); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)
  via `scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh` — stage `dupx`, ONE jscpd
  invocation, marker-parity with the CI `guards` job (which also runs it
  for app-only PRs — cross-module clones are usually born app-side).
  Baseline 0.3013% of the combined ~283k lines, pinned 0.31 in
  `ci_fast_gate.sh` (ratchet — only tighten; the per-package gates above
  cannot see across module boundaries).

    exception).

    uses (the two `flutter-tests` shards emit `--coverage`; the

surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # gh-1039 — main CI fix plan: picker test + agent_cli size gate + structuralDiff CRAP

### What changed
Three independent fixes for the red main CI (run 36399539696), one commit each:
1. `test(app)` — `flutter_app/test/media_slot_picker_page_test.dart` updated to the deliberate post-#975 add-provider flow (contract defined by [`d54180f0`](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/commit/d54180f0), the #975 single add-provider flow, PR #979): "Add provider" opens `AddProviderPresetPickerPage`, "Custom" routes to `ProviderEditorPage`; the saved provider then lists on the picker and opens its model page prefilled. That commit updated the fa_ui twin of this test and pinned the contract in `add_provider_flow_unify_test.dart` but missed the flutter_app copy — production code was already correct, only the test was stale.
2. `refactor(cli)` — extracted the diagnostic-log members (`_logDiagnostic`, `_logSid`, `_appendDiagnosticLog`, `_diagnosticLogPath`) from `agent_cli.dart` into `agent_cli_diag_log.dart` (`part of` + private extension, the established `agent_cli_banner.dart`/`agent_cli_inbox.dart` pattern). Pure move: 2815 → 2774 lines, zero behavior change.
3. `refactor(omp-reg)` — split `structuralDiff` (CRAP 17.15: CC 11 @ 63% cov) into `_chromeRows`/`_chromeRowCountFinding`, `_statusBarFindings`, `_segmentFindings` + a thin composer, with byte-identical finding texts. New tests pin every branch through the public API (presence drift both directions, bar-less parity, single segment-count finding, 2-item drift loop).

### Key decisions
- Break 1 keeps the new flow (not a revert): `d54180f0` (issue #975, PR #979) deliberately routed every add-provider entry through the ONE settings flow and its contract tests pin `AddProviderPresetPickerPage` opening before any editor.
- Break 2 is a mechanical extraction — the diff shows moved code only; `_diagnosticLogDirEnsured` stays on the class (extensions hold no fields).
- Break 3 tests are characterization-first (written and run against the old monolith before the split), matching the ticket's "split + tests" contract; `crap4dart.yaml` untouched.
- No thresholds relaxed, no tests skipped or quarantined (I1/AC5).

```bash

dart pub global run crap4dart analyze lib/src/cli/omp_reg_normalizer.dart   # max 9.00 OK (threshold 12)

dart test test/cli/omp_reg_normalizer_test.dart test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart  # 16 passed
dart analyze                                                      # clean
```
